record.field: Obligations to meet when ordering medication

Obligations to meet when ordering medication

For belgian veterinary practioners

  • Being the manager of a veterinary medical depot and having sent us the number of the depot in question.
  • Being a registered and paid-up member of the Veterinary Practitioners’ Association

For belgian pharmacies and wholesalers

  • Being in possession of an APB number (for pharmacies) or a (933V) permit for distributing veterinary medication (for wholesalers) and having communicated this number/ permit to us.

Eligible persons outside of belgium

  • Please contact Alcyon in order to send a copy of a certificate/ degree/ permit on an ad hoc basis.

Royal Decree of 21 July 2016 relating to the conditions of use of medicines by veterinary practitioners and those taking care of animals.
